title: Bufalin Suppresses Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Through ER Stress-Ferroptosis Crosstalk Associated with IP(3)R-Linked Ca(2+) Dysregulation and ATF3/SLC7A11 Regulation.
authors: Yang, Pei-Wen; Li, Xin; Si, Wai-Mei; Zhang, Yuan; Kong, Xiang-Yu; Xu, Xin-Yi; Zhu, Xiao-Yan; Chen, Zhen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蟾毒灵通过ER应激-铁死亡串扰抑制胰腺癌，涉及ATF3/SLC7A11调控，但核心是细胞死亡机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly aggressive malignancy characterized by therapeutic resistance and poor prognosis, underscoring the need for new therapeutic strategies. Bufalin, a major bioactive constituent of Venenum bufonis, has shown antitumor activity in several cancer types; however, its mechanism of action in PDAC remains incompletely defined. In this study, we investigated the antitumor effects of bufalin in PDAC using in vitro assays, mouse tumor models, and integrative transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, and bioinformatic analyses. Bufalin inhibited PDAC cell viability, clonogenic growth, migration, and tumor progression in vivo. Pharmacological rescue experiments indicated that ferroptosis contributes importantly to bufalin-induced cytotoxicity, although apoptosis- and pyroptosis-related pathways may also be involved. Multi-omics analyses revealed coordinated alterations in calcium homeostasis, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress/unfolded protein response (UPR) signaling, and ferroptosis-related metabolic pathways. Further experiments showed that bufalin was associated with disrupted intracellular Ca(2+) homeostasis, IP(3)R-linked ER Ca(2+) release, activation of PERK/eIF2alpha/ATF4 signaling, increased ATF3 expression, reduced SLC7A11 and GPX4 expression, glutathione depletion, and enhanced lipid peroxidation. Molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance assays supported an in vitro physical interaction between bufalin and IP(3)R1/IP(3)R3, while inhibition of ER stress attenuated several bufalin-induced ferroptosis-related phenotypes. Bioinformatic analyses further showed that higher ER stress and ferroptosis signature scores were associated with improved overall survival in PDAC, and concurrent activation of both signatures was linked to the most favorable prognosis. Collectively, these findings support that bufalin suppresses PDAC progression through coordinated ER stress- and ferroptosis-related responses, highlighting ER stress-ferroptosis crosstalk as a potential therapeutic vulnerability in PDAC.
abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC）是一种高度侵袭性恶性肿瘤，以治疗耐药和预后不良为特征，凸显了对新治疗策略的需求。蟾毒灵（bufalin）是蟾酥（Venenum bufonis）的主要生物活性成分，已在多种癌症类型中显示出抗肿瘤活性；然而，其在PDAC中的作用机制尚未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们通过体外实验、小鼠肿瘤模型以及整合的转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和生物信息学分析，探讨了蟾毒灵在PDAC中的抗肿瘤效应。蟾毒灵在体内抑制了PDAC细胞活力、克隆形成生长、迁移及肿瘤进展。药理学挽救实验表明，铁死亡（ferroptosis）在蟾毒灵诱导的细胞毒性中发挥重要作用，尽管凋亡和焦亡相关通路也可能参与其中。多组学分析揭示了钙稳态、内质网（endoplasmic reticulum, ER）应激/未折叠蛋白反应（unfolded protein response, UPR）信号传导以及铁死亡相关代谢通路的协调变化。进一步实验显示，蟾毒灵与细胞内Ca(2+)稳态破坏、IP(3)R相关的ER Ca(2+)释放、PERK/eIF2alpha/ATF4信号激活、ATF3表达增加、SLC7A11和GPX4表达降低、谷胱甘肽耗竭以及脂质过氧化增强相关。分子对接和表面等离子体共振实验支持蟾毒灵与IP(3)R1/IP(3)R3之间存在体外物理相互作用，而抑制ER应激则减弱了蟾毒灵诱导的若干铁死亡相关表型。生物信息学分析进一步表明，较高的ER应激和铁死亡特征评分与PDAC中更好的总生存期相关，且两种特征的同步激活与最有利的预后相关联。总体而言，这些发现支持蟾毒灵通过协调的ER应激和铁死亡相关反应抑制PDAC进展，凸显了ER应激-铁死亡串扰作为PDAC潜在治疗靶点的可能性。
